ModMetaData.name: Bumbledrone Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces sarg.alphaanimals's AA_Bumbledrone art (adult lifeStage look, south/east/north facings only - any alternate-skin or dessicated-corpse textures stay on donor art) with an invented-recast render generated for this campaign. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_Bumbledrone/AA_Bumbledrone_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
